panels.head: Shop and published promotions
body: Gift cards are physical cards sent by USPS, not email gift cards. The website lists $25, $50 and $100 options. Online merchandise prices include US shipping; confirm stock and size availability directly.
The business publishes a 4.5% service fee. Promotions cannot be stacked. Confirm eligibility and current offers with the shop.

films.caption:
🍦 NEED A FROYO PICK-ME-UP? 👀 @easybreezyofficial is a NEW froyo spot in Walnut Creek! Perfect for a midday treat, with yogurt made in-house daily, rotating flavors, and tons of toppings to build your own sweet creation! 🤩🍨

🍦 I tried:
🤍 Vanilla Custard
🍫 Chocolate Custard
🍍 Vegan Disneyland Whip
🌱 Vegan Vanilla Bean
🥛 Original Tart

Whether you’re craving something rich and creamy or light and tangy, there’s a flavor for everyone! 😋

📍 @easybreezyofficial — Walnut Creek

Who’s ready for a froyo run? 👇
